name: Tandy TRS-80 Model III
credits: Layout after the Tandy TRS-80 Model III (1980) 65-key keyboard; colours after its grey case and dark grey caps with white legends.
notes: Faithful: the Model III's 65 keys in their rows and order, with BREAK at the end of the number row, ↑ and ↓ at the left of the Q and A rows, @ ← → after P, ENTER and CLEAR after ;, the twelve-key numeric keypad with its own ENTER on the right, the shifted legends above the characters, dark grey caps with white upper-case legends on the grey case, and a blank space bar. Letters type lower case and SHIFT upper case. ← erases the last character, as it did on the Model III; → moves right, ↑ and ↓ step through the command history, ENTER is return and CLEAR is escape. Keypad keys type their digits. Approximated: widths are compressed to fit a phone and there is no gap before the keypad (a row cannot hold one). Mapped to none: BREAK (it stopped a BASIC program). Both Tandys ship: this Model III and the Tandy 1000 (tandy1000).
